pydep-pilot.view.title: PyDepPilot
pydep-pilot.config.customPypiUrl.descrip: Custom PyPI mirror URL (leave empty to use official PyPI)
pydep-pilot.config.packageManager.descri: Which tool runs package operations. "auto" uses uv only for environments that uv created and uv is on PATH; otherwise pip.
pydep-pilot.config.packageManager.auto: Use uv for uv-created environments when uv is installed, otherwise pip
pydep-pilot.config.packageManager.uv: Always use uv (falls back to pip with a warning if uv is not on PATH)
